source: Ghahari et al. Scientific Data 2025, Tables 2-4

action_rules.AcquireDerm: adjacent-record dermoscopy-presence onset: dermoscopy id present at this chained record and absent at the immediately previous chained record. This is a derived event proxy, not a logged clinician action. It is not identical to first-ever observed dermoscopy on the chain.
action_rules.ReferExcise: pathology-linked endpoint proxy. If Histopathologic_Result flips from false to true, the proxy is aligned to that record (pathology-flag-change). If the flag is constant AND there is histopathology-true or cancer-coded diagnosis evidence, the proxy is placed at the last chained record (lesion-level endpoint). Chains with no histopathology and no cancer-coded diagnosis receive no ReferExcise label. Not a timestamped referral decision.
